name: Guru Academy
positioning: "AI-native training institution" for the Arab world; AI strategy, agentic systems, enterprise deployment
strongest_content: Programme catalogue across strategy and engineering
search_visibility_evidence: Surfaced first in a search for "corporate AI training provider Egypt executives workshops" (2026-10-25)
technical_notes: Own domain not confirmed from the directory listing
opportunity_for_menova: Their claim "Certified by Anthropic" is unverified. Menova competes on a named, verifiable instructor with an AUC appointment rather than on institutional claims

name: EduDelphi Egypt
positioning: Delphi AI Academy — practical AI learning track; in-person / live online / blended / private cohort
search_visibility_evidence: Surfaced in the same Egypt query
opportunity_for_menova: Format flexibility is their lead. Menova leads on who delivers and on documented engagements; no competitor found publishes named client case studies

name: CLS Learning Solutions
positioning: Long-established IT training house (since 1995) with AI and data science tracks
search_visibility_evidence: Named in search summary for Egypt corporate training
opportunity_for_menova: They are certification-led and technical. Menova's non-technical executive framing is a genuinely different product

name: Olligence AI
positioning: AI academy reporting ~1,000 trainees/month; targeting EGP 100m sales in 2026
technical_notes: Own site not located in this research
opportunity_for_menova: Not a competitor for leadership teams — evidence that the Egyptian Arabic AI-training SERP is dominated by individual/volume upskilling rather than executive work

name: ALX Enterprise
positioning: Workforce reskilling for AI adoption; runs HR/L&D leadership sessions in Cairo
strongest_content: Enterprise reskilling programmes + recurring Cairo events
opportunity_for_menova: They own the HR/L&D convening ground in Cairo. Menova has no event presence — a distribution gap rather than a content gap

name: LEORON Institute
positioning: "AI at Work — the complete applied AI program for leaders"
strongest_content: Structured multi-day leader programme with an Arabic landing page
search_visibility_evidence: Ranked in an Arabic executive-AI-training query
technical_notes: Has Arabic URL path — direct hreflang competitor in Arabic
opportunity_for_menova: Closest structural competitor in the Gulf. They are an institute selling a catalogue; Menova sells a named practitioner. Differentiate on delivery-by-the-principal and on client-data exercises

name: GLOMACS
positioning: Open-enrolment AI courses in Riyadh and across the Gulf
strongest_content: Published course calendar with dates and fees
search_visibility_evidence: Named in a Riyadh executive AI training search
technical_notes: A specific Riyadh AI course URL returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-25 — their fee figures could NOT be verified first-hand
opportunity_for_menova: They publish prices and dates. That transparency is their advantage and the reason /insights/what-corporate-ai-training-costs/ was written

name: AI Superior
positioning: AI strategy training for executives; also publishes "AI training companies" listicles
strongest_content: Listicle pages that rank for provider-discovery queries
search_visibility_evidence: Ranked in the Arabic executive training query
opportunity_for_menova: Listicles are how buyers shortlist. Being included in one is a distribution task, not a content task

name: Improving
positioning: Role-based AI training delivered onsite or virtually
search_visibility_evidence: Ranked in the Egypt query despite having no Egypt presence
opportunity_for_menova: International firms rank in local queries on authority alone. Local proof — Arabic delivery, EGP invoicing, no travel line in Cairo — is the counter-argument, and it is already on the geo pages

name: Edstellar
strongest_content: Listicle that ranks for the buyer-shortlist query
technical_notes: Menova is not on this list. Getting listed is a concrete, ethical distribution action

name: ClickUp (blog)
positioning: "Top 10 AI courses for executives" — an Arabic-language listicle from a SaaS brand
strongest_content: Ranked top-3 in an Arabic executive-AI-course query
ai_citation_evidence: Arabic localisation of a high-authority SaaS blog
technical_notes: Evidence that Arabic executive-AI-course SERPs are won by translated SaaS content marketing, not by trainers. Original Arabic practitioner content is an open lane

name: AUC School of Business Executive Education
positioning: Ranked executive education; AI-adjacent short courses (e.g. "Data and AI-Driven Business Decisions")
search_visibility_evidence: Listed via third-party course directories (Educatly); no AI programme page confirmed on its own domain
opportunity_for_menova: Ahmed teaches here. A link from an AUC instructor bio page to the site is the single highest-value backlink available and is already item 3 on LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md

name: Ahmed Abdel Razek (Zoka)
positioning: AI speaker, educator and community builder; founder of Sahaba Club, creator of PromptArena; claims a 1m+ Arabic tech community
search_visibility_evidence: Top result for an Arabic AI speaker/trainer query
technical_notes: Visible via Sessionize rather than an owned domain
opportunity_for_menova: The closest individual peer found. He is community-led and developer-leaning; Menova is corporate and non-technical. The lesson is distribution: his visibility comes from community and speaking, not from his website

name: Udemy / Coursera / for9a (Arabic AI courses)
positioning: Self-paced Arabic AI courses — mostly Python and technical
technical_notes: Dominates the Arabic query "أفضل كورس تعلم الذكاء الاصطناعي"
source: The main substitute a buyer will raise ("why not just buy Udemy seats?"). The answer — self-paced libraries do not change how a management team decides — is now argued on /insights/what-corporate-ai-training-costs/
